decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single storey side extension and detached outbuilding, would, by reason of their bulk, disproportionate size, position and appearance constitute an overdevelopment of the site and form an obtrusive feature, harmful to neighbours' living conditions, resulting in loss of outlook and of light, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed outbuilding would not be acceptable due to its position, size, design and appearance. It would overdevelop the site  and would harm the appearance of the area contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and  H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension, rear roof extension incorporating two roof lights to front roof slope and erection of detached outbuilding for use as a playroom and gym to house.
